items.text: Hello fellow Architects!
I'm standing proud today to finally bring you the Panorama Update!
We have a massive changelog this time, with lots of new ways to make your golf club more beautiful, more natural, and a little more wild.
Let's jump into it!
Scenic Trees are both beautiful and strategic!
They're much bigger than regular trees, which means they're also very effective at keeping golfers from taking unwanted shortcuts across your course.
Just keep an eye on their maintenance costs — beauty doesn't come for free!
We've added a variety of new décor items to let you further customize your golf club and give it a bit more personality!
More rocks!
You can now decorate your course with Small, Medium, and Large Rocks, giving you more options when shaping the landscape of your club.
Water just got a lot more interesting!
Raising or lowering terrain underneath water can now generate waterfalls, and you'll also be able to see the direction in which the water flows.
Please note: this system also affects your existing saved golf clubs, so you may find some unexpected waterfalls appearing in older courses.
If you spot one somewhere you don't want it, don't panic! Just terraform the area a little and you'll be good to go.
Gotta catch 'em all!
Certain combinations of terrain and structures can now attract animals to your golf club.
We'll let you discover exactly what attracts what...
And let's just say we're already thinking about the fantastic opportunities this could open up in the future.
We've added a brand-new terrain type: Overgrown Rough.
Long, wild grass loves to swallow golf balls, and for the moment this terrain has the highest chance of causing a missed stroke.
So use it wisely when designing your holes... or don't. Your golfers might hate you, but that's part of being an Architect!
Fixed various Play Golf data for the various terrain types.
Terrain underneath décor now displays correctly.
Fixed the Elephant Bush statue collider being roughly twice the size it should have been. That's one BIG elephant.
Various mouseover fixes.
Added some extra love to the building experience.
Fixed missing LODs on golfer clothing. No more accidental naked golfing!
Fixed mouseover detection while demolishing, which could sometimes disappear.
We're aware that reaching -50k currently causes bankruptcy, potentially making you lose a significant amount of progress.
We agree that this can be really frustrating.
We're working on a better solution where bankruptcy will still have consequences, but won't suddenly wipe out a huge amount of your progress.
More on this soon!
On a different note, we've heard your requests for a Beta Branch, and the answer is YES!
Next week we'll publish a short news post explaining how to access the Beta Branch, what you can expect to find there, and how you can help us test upcoming features.
Now we will focus on some gameplay mechanics and customization in the Signature Update with expected delivery, October! Some minor updated with bug fixed along the way can be expected!
I will get more in to details in a future news on what to expect in the Signature Update!
Thank you, as always, for playing, sharing your feedback, and helping us improve Under Par Golf Architect.
Hope to see you soon on the green! ⛳
Yves
Hello fellow Architects!
I'm here with an update that you don't want, but you definitely need! ːsteamsadː
Before we jump into the patch notes, I want to publicly address some feedback we've received.
We know that updates have felt a little slow lately, and that new content is taking longer than you'd like to arrive. We hear you!

The reality is that we're also finishing another game, and being a relatively small studio, it's inevitable that things slow down a little on our other projects during the final 3 weeks before a launch.
But! Starting in September, updates will become much heavier on content. We're also reorganizing our updates around specific themes, which will allow us to share a clearer roadmap with you very soon!
And that brings us to the first of these "organized" updates...
Update 1.1.12, the Smooth Swing Update ⛳
This time, we're focusing on **optimization and performance**, especially on lower-end hardware and consoles.
New & Improved
Golfer LODs: Golfers now use different Levels of Detail depending on their distance from the camera. The farther away they are, the less geometry the game needs to render.
Better Golfer AI Performance: We've optimized golfer AI to reduce CPU-intensive calculations while also improving their behaviour.
Better Terrain Calculations: We've optimized terrain-building calculations to make building and terraforming less demanding.
Bug Fixes
Animals now spawn correctly: You'll still need to find the right combination of terrain and structures to attract them!
When returning from a Sandbox level to the Career Map, the caddy will now spawn near the correct level.
Various minor bug fixes and improvements.
Demo Update
We also took a moment to update the demo with all the improvements we've made since release!
So, while this update might not bring you a shiny new toy to play with, hopefully you'll notice something just as important:
a smoother Under Par! ⛳
And from September... we'll get back to adding more toys. 😄
Hope to see you on the green
Yves
PS: We also "fixed" the key art golfer pose
Hello Fellow Architects
It took us a little longer than expected, but the wait is finally over the new Fence System is here!

notes.title: You now have three new fence types to choose from

items.text: Short Fence
Medium Fence
Tall Fence
Fence Details
The new fences are more than just decorative!
Golfers and your avatar can no longer walk through fences.
Golf balls will now bounce off fences instead of passing through them.
If a ball comes to rest next to a fence, the lie will be treated as Default Terrain.
The legacy fences are no longer available in the build menu. If you load an older save, existing old fences will still be there you can sell them, but you won't be able to build any new ones.
Community Feedback
Thanks to your feedback, we've also made a couple of improvements:
Golf balls now come out clean after landing in water or going Out of Bounds.
You can now see whether you've completed all V.I.P. missions for a level.
Fixed controller navigation when selecting Flower Beds.
Fixed incorrect tournament score display.
You can now sell golf terrain even while in debt (when you need the money most!).
Various minor bug fixes.
What's Next
With most of our initial roadmap now in a good place,
we've started looking at the next big improvements, beginning with a complete overhaul of the water system and new terrains! More soon!

We've also received some concerning feedback about performance, not just on consoles, but on PC as well. Improving optimization is now one of our top priorities, so we're working hard to deliver that 360 no-scope, 300 FPS, GG WP experience. ːchicken_wowː
Steam Machine

We also tested the game on the new Steam machine to make sure we're ready for its launch, and we're happy to report that the experience was excellent. We're super happy with the results and really hope you will be too!
I hope to see you on the green
Yves

items.text: Hello fellow architects!
Today I'm here to talk a little bit bout the new addition to the game and the Out of Bound ( OB) rework!
First thing first, we added more customization to the Trees, now you can chose between 3 different size:
1) Small: golfer will try to shoot over them, the better the golfer less of an obstacle this size of tree are.
2) Medium: the normal size that you are all familiar with.
3) Tall: golfer will not attempt to throw over them, it's almost impossible
Rocks: it's not Ob anymore, but the ball bounces erratically when it lands in rocks. and if the ball end in the rock even after the bounce it triggers the "relief for an unplayable ball".
Trees: it's not Ob anymore, relief for an unplayable ball in case it's too much under a tree
Water: relief for an unplayable ball
Path: it's not Ob anymore, will be handled like the default terrane ("Base").
OB: too far from the current hole
Relief for an unplayable ball

If your ball comes to rest in a position where a shot is not reasonably possible, such as deep bushes, heavy rough, or obstructed terrain, you may declare the ball unplayable. Taking relief adds a one-stroke penalty, after which the ball is repositioned to the nearest valid point on the current hole.
Start screen now works also with the mouse click and not only with the space bar.
New "Live it! stats effect" settings that will toggle the Hunger, thirst, energy and bathroom effects while playing golf.
No more Bankruptcy in Sandbox
Not showing the follow cam while playing Golf!
I hope this little/big update is a right step in the right direction, let us know what you think.
See you on the green
Yves

notes.title: A quick hotfix patch to address two major issues

items.text: 1) For all German players, we discovered a localization problem that breaks the mission from Level 6 onwards. This patch should fix it. We’re not sure if it will repair existing save files—if you still experience issues, please restart Level 6, “Seidenstraße.”

2) All buildings and props are now unlocked in Sandbox Mode. This feature was originally planned for Friday’s patch, but it was already included in the project when we discovered the German localization bug.
I’d also like to take a moment to address some of the issues players are reporting:

Score System: Many players are leaving negative reviews because they don’t understand the “Handicap” system. We are currently investigating how to improve this—possibly by making the Handicap system optional in the settings.

Day 1 DLC: This decision unfortunately backfired, as some players feel exploited or perceive us as a greedy company. In reality, this choice was made in good faith: we wanted to keep the base game under $20 so more players could try it. We also aim to support our games long-term with updates and improvements.

Bugs: We tested the game extensively: two public playtests, more than four months of public demo, and both internal and external QA. However, nothing compares to thousands of players engaging with the game simultaneously. Please be patient—the team is already working hard to fix the reported issues :)

“Discouraging” Hard Holes: This is a misconception. The game is designed to start with more accessible levels for amateur players. As you progress, golfers become more advanced and naturally expect more challenging, less repetitive holes.

AI use: In Broken Arms Games we believe in the craftmanship of the art in videogame, so NO AI TOOL where used in production with the onlyu exeption of ChatGpt to correct the patch notes and some social/marketing post. We are not native English speaker team so we whrite stuff in ItalianEnglish and use this tool to correct the grammar :)

Golfer not following waypoints/ hitting trees: at the moment the goplfer think they are too good for what they are in reality, we can change that the golfer try to shoot toward the waypoints, but this will open up a lot of new unwahted behaviors. So now is time to fine tune this befhaviors and find the best solution, maybe let's talk about it togheter on discord or here on the Comunity HUB

Overall, we made this game with a lot of love and care. Every decision was carefully considered, although we are working within budget constraints. We are human, and we read all your feedback and reviews—please keep the discussion respectful, this will go a long way for the morale of the team involved.
Tournament scoring displayed as +/- relative to par
Camera tilt with controller

Cursor movement in “Live It!” mode will no longer move the camera
Less intrusive hole design overlay
Quality-of-life improvements, including clearer career mode progression and skill point usage
More customization options and decorations
AI golfer and Career Mode balancing
New hole rating system
And much more!

Thank you all so much for the amazing feedback—it truly means a lot to us, and if you would like to support our work you can help us a lot by leaving a review here on steam, this will signal the steam algoritme to "work" for us and not "against" us :)
Best,
Yves

notes.title: 🏌️‍♂️ Under Par Golf Architect – Major Update!

items.text: Hello Architects!
We’re here to drop a hot new update — our biggest so far! 🔥 We’ve received an incredible amount of feedback, and we’ve worked quickly to address it.
Close the Gate System – Close the main gate and all golfers will leave the course instantly.
Map Selection Improvements – The map selection carousel can now be moved using mouse clicks.
Adjusted course rating balance — previously required too many greens and hazards to achieve an A rating.
Golfers will no longer aim shots toward other holes.
Reduced tendency to always pick the shortest path, allowing more creative course layouts.
Ongoing improvements to shot simulation.
Fixed issues with the hole solver when water interrupts paths.
Long shots are now more powerful.
Putting difficulty increased for more realistic outcomes.
Weed and Trash will effect only nearby golfers!
You can see weed and trash in the overlay menu.
Overlay menu changed white to dark gray to save your eyes!
Ongoing tuning of golfer needs (hunger, thirst, energy).
Fixed an issue where golfers would not complete the final hole during tournaments.
Golfers now prioritize closer options to satisfy their needs.
AI will now properly exit the course when gates are closed.
Improved gardener activity levels.
Fixed NavMesh issues causing agents to get stuck with high population counts.
Reduced pathfinding problems in forest areas (now walkable with higher movement cost).
Added UI support for golfer groups.
Groups can now share outfits for better visual clarity.
Increased recovery capacity (previously limited to one employee at a time).
Benches
Queue limited to 1 for clearer and more predictable behavior.
Increased effective range of trash bins.
Expanded UI with more detailed and useful information.
Improved clarity on how course ratings are influenced by reviews.
Added better visibility into golfer preferences (e.g., decorations like flowerbeds).
Now you can see where the golfers is headed!
Queues now reorder dynamically based on actual agent positions.
Tutorial/demo difficulty is currently too high (will be balanced in a future update).
It can be difficult to understand when and where money is earned.
Golfer hole ratings are not always clearly visible.
Some 3D UI elements interfere with mouse clicks (e.g., hole lock pins).
IM SURE I'M MISSING SOMETHING!!!!!!!!!!!!! ( For example the quality settings in the settings -.-)
Thanks again for your amazing feedback — it’s helping us shape the game in a big way 💚 If you're enjoying the progress, consider leaving a Steam review — it helps us a lot!
See you on the course! ⛳
